promptGuidelines: Use ask_user_question for decisions only the user can make: approach, scope, trade-offs, preferences. Never ask for facts you can find with tools — look them up first.
Batch independent questions (up to 4) into one call. A question whose answer depends on another still-open question belongs in a later call, after that answer arrives.
Each question: 2-4 options, a 1-5 word label and a description of the trade-off. Recommended option first, with "(Recommended)" appended. Never author "Other" or "Type something." rows.
Use previews only to compare concrete artifacts (code, configs, mockups); single-select only.
If the user cancels (Esc), do not re-ask the same questionnaire; list the open decisions in text instead.
